scheme_name: The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Old Age Assistance Scheme
other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Andaman and Nicobar Islands or have resided there for at least 10 years
Must not be receiving any other financial assistance, pension, or grant from the government or any other source
benefits_summary: Provides monthly assistance of ₹2,500 for ages 60‑79 and ₹3,000 for ages 80 and above.
